# Review an issue

The rules are in the yardhand section of AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md). Read it first. When this repo has the CLI (`npx yardhand`, or `pnpm dlx yardhand` / `bunx yardhand`), use it for new IDs, status moves and front matter. Without it, follow the rules in that section exactly. That section also says what each status means; never move an issue into or out of a status that has no description unless asked.

1. Read the issue's ISSUE.md and the change on its branch.
2. If you are the issue's `assignee`, or you built it, stop. Say it needs another reviewer.
3. Check every acceptance criterion against the change. A criterion passes only if the change shows it.
4. If all pass, move the issue to the status after its current one (the order is in `issues/yardhand.json`).
5. If any fail, untick them, add a `## Review notes` section at the end of the ISSUE.md saying what is missing, and move the issue back to `in-progress`.
6. Run `npx yardhand validate` before you finish.
